title: atitara major
intro: Atitara major, commonly known as Strychnos nux-vomica, is a plant species belonging to the Loganiaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Atitara major include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Atitara major include alkaloids like strychnine and brucine, which exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties.
